top_signals.title: OPEC Sees Oil Demand Growth Explode Sixfold in 2027
top_signals.summary: OPEC now expects global oil demand growth to jump from just 380,000 barrels per day this year to 2.36 million bpd in 2027—a more than sixfold increase in the space of a year. The cartel trimmed its 2026 demand-growth forecast in its September Monthly Oil Market Report, putting total consumption this year at 105.84 million bpd. For 2027, OPEC raised its forecast, with global demand expected to reach 108.19 million bpd. The swing is especially stark in China. top_signals.title: Fanatics’ King on Sports Betting and Prediction Markets
top_signals.summary: Fanatics’ Betting and Gaming CEO Matt King discusses the company’s newly launched all-in-one app, which combines sports betting, casino, and prediction markets. King discusses Fanatics’ position in a market long dominated by DraftKings and FanDuel, and asked King how much share Fanatics has gained so far. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
